Who pays whom: Refiners and manufacturers pay mining and commodity suppliers.
Major costs and risks: Commodity prices, energy and extraction costs

Who pays whom: Chipmakers pay wafer, chemical and gas suppliers.
Major costs and risks: Purification facilities, qualification and production costs

Who pays whom: Chip designers and semiconductor firms pay EDA vendors and IP licensors.
Foundries and memory firms pay ASML, Applied Materials, Lam Research, KLA and others.
Major costs and risks: R&D, manufacturing complexity and investment cycles

Who pays whom: NVIDIA, AMD and other designers pay TSMC, Samsung, Intel Foundry and other foundries.
Major costs and risks: Fab construction, depreciation, yields and utilization

Who pays whom: Accelerator designers and system makers pay memory and packaging suppliers.
Major costs and risks: Capacity investment, yields and demand cycles

Who pays whom: Cloud providers, enterprises and governments pay chip, server and networking vendors.
Major costs and risks: Hardware development, inventory and supply commitments

Who pays whom: AI labs, enterprises and developers pay cloud and infrastructure operators.
Major costs and risks: GPUs, power, construction, cooling and financing

Who pays whom: API users, subscribers and enterprises pay model providers. Investors finance expansion.
Major costs and risks: Training, inference, talent, research and customer acquisition

Who pays whom: Businesses, governments and consumers pay software vendors and AI startups.
Major costs and risks: Model API fees, engineering, sales and distribution

Who pays whom: Consumers, enterprises and governments pay for AI services and potential productivity gains.
